name: s3
description: This section explains prominent concepts and notations in the set of high-level S3 commands provided.

subcommands.name: ls
subcommands.description: List S3 objects and common prefixes under a prefix or all S3 buckets. Note that the --output and --no-paginate arguments are ignored for this command

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Command is performed on all files or objects under the specified directory or prefix

options.name: --page-size
options.description: The number of results to return in each response to a list operation. The default value is 1000 (the maximum allowed).

options.name: --human-readable
options.description: Displays file sizes in human readable format

options.name: --summarize
options.description: Displays summary information (number of objects, total size)

options.name: --request-payer
options.description: Confirms that the requester knows that they will be charged for the request. Bucket owners need not specify this parameter in their requests.

subcommands.description: Copies a local file or S3 object to another location locally or in S3

options.description: Symbolic links are followed only when uploading to S3 from the local filesystem.

options.description: Do not try to guess the mime type for uploaded files.  By default the mime type of a file is guessed when it is uploaded

options.name: --sse
options.description: Specifies server-side encryption of the object in S3. Valid values are ``AES256`` and ``aws:kms``.

options.name: --sse-c
options.description: Specifies server-side encryption using customer provided keys of the the object in S3. ``AES256`` is the only valid value.

options.name: --sse-c-key
options.description: The customer-provided encryption key to use to server-side encrypt the object in S3. If you provide this value, ``--sse-c`` must be specified as well.

options.name: --sse-kms-key-id
options.description: The customer-managed AWS Key Management Service (KMS) key ID that should be used to server-side encrypt the object in S3.

options.name: --sse-c-copy-source
options.description: This parameter should only be specified when copying an S3 object that was encrypted server-side with a customer-provided key.

subcommands.name: rb
subcommands.description: Deletes an empty S3 bucket. A bucket must be completely empty of objects and versioned objects before it can be deleted.

options.name: --force
options.description: Deletes all objects in the bucket including the bucket itself.

subcommands.name: presign
subcommands.description: Generate a pre-signed URL for an Amazon S3 object. This allows anyone who receives the pre-signed URL to retrieve the S3 object with an HTTP GET request.

options.name: --expires-in
options.description: Number of seconds until the pre-signed URL expires.  Default is 3600 seconds
